subject: CloudBridge partner credit request and issuance for PLG signup campaign
messages:
From: Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: partner-issued credits for CloudBridge PLG signups

Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our partnerships team. We're launching a promotional push next month aimed at developer signups that originate from CloudBridge's marketplace listing. We want to offer a $150 Redwood credit redeemable in self-serve (no-sales handoff) for qualified signups.

Can Redwood issue partner-funded credits (voucher codes that redeem through your PLG flow) and provide a bulk redemption report back to us weekly? Attached is the campaign spec and our partner credit request form. Key details: campaign window Feb 1–Mar 15, estimated 1–1.5k redemptions, CloudBridge covers promo spend.

What's the approval path and typical SLA for issuance? We need PR/finance details to complete the commitment.

Thanks,
Eve Lin
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued credits for CloudBridge PLG signups

Eve — thanks for the note and the materials. This is doable; a few operational questions so we scope the approval correctly:
- Do you want one-time voucher codes (issued in bulk) or single-use codes per signup?
- Billing/chargeback: will CloudBridge be billed monthly for actual redemptions or prepay a pool?
- Any KYC/compliance needs for CloudBridge to be on file (we typically require a partner billing contact and W-9/PO for larger commitments).

I'll loop in Marissa from Partner Ops and Ben from Sales Ops to expedite approvals and coordinate the reporting hooks. If those answers are quick we can aim to have draft voucher sets in 3–5 business days.

Best,
Karthik
Account Lead, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued credits for CloudBridge PLG signups

Hi Eve — looping in Finance & Ops. Quick answers:
- We support both single-use and bulk pool vouchers. For high-volume PLG flows we recommend single-use codes tied to CloudBridge referral IDs to reduce fraud.
- For estimated 1–1.5k redemptions at $150 each, that's $150k–$225k. Finance prefers a prepaid pool for easier reconciliation, but we can support monthly invoicing with a PO + net30 if CloudBridge prefers.
- We'll need a signed partner credit agreement (I've attached our standard form) and CloudBridge's billing contact + tax form. Also attaching a short usage snapshot template for weekly reporting.

Next steps for CloudBridge: confirm single-use vs pool, confirm billing preference, and sign the attached credit form. Once we have that, Ops can generate codes and provide a redemption webhook and weekly CSV delivery.

-Marissa
Partner Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: partner_credit_request_form.pdf, cloudbridge_campaign_spec.xlsx, audited_usage_snapshot.csv

-----
From: Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued credits for CloudBridge PLG signups

Thanks Marissa — we'll go with single-use codes tied to referral IDs. CloudBridge will prepay a $175k pool to leave a buffer for over-redemption; we'll submit a PO for that amount and the signed credit form this week. Billing contact will be Thomas Cheng (thomas.cheng@cloudbridge.com).

A couple of operational asks:
- Can Redwood expose a JSON webhook with each redemption (email, referral_id, code, usd_value, timestamp)?
- Will you redact tokens in the weekly CSV (PII minimization)?

We'll return the signed form by end of day Thursday.

Best,
Eve

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval needed: CloudBridge $175k prepaid partner credit pool

Team — CloudBridge confirmed single-use codes and will prepay $175k. We need approval to create 1,200 single-use voucher codes mapped to referral IDs and to set up the weekly redemption webhook.

Recommended controls:
- Cap redemptions at 1,500 codes total; unused balance refundable after campaign close.
- Require referral_id validation on redemption endpoint to reduce bots.
- Weekly CSV export delivered to partners@cloudbridge.com (email + referral_id + usd_value + ISO timestamp).

Laura — can Finance confirm the prepaid acceptance process and the ledger treatment? If OK, Ops will schedule code generation on Friday.

Thanks,
Ben
Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: CloudBridge $175k prepaid partner credit pool

Ben / team — finance confirms: prepaid accepted into deferred revenue (campaign liability). We need the PO (CB-PO-5791) and vendor billing contact (Thomas Cheng) before we can apply funds. Refund process: any unused balance returned minus processing fees within 30 days of campaign end.

Approving the issuance and operational controls as outlined. Ops, please ensure weekly reports are anonymized to exclude full tokens and PII; use hashed email if needed.

-Laur a
VP Finance — Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Codes issued: CloudBridge campaign live + redemption webhook details

Eve — thanks for the PO and signed form (received this morning). Ops has generated 1,250 single-use voucher codes and loaded them into the marketplace redemption service. Summary below: 

- Pool amount: $175,000 prepaid (PO CB-PO-5791)
- Codes generated: 1,250 single-use vouchers at $140 face value (we built a cushion for partial redemptions/fees)
- Redemption webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/partner-redemptions/cloudbridge
- Weekly report delivery: every Monday 08:00 PST to partners@cloudbridge.com (CSV with hashed_email, referral_id, code, usd_value, iso_timestamp)
- Campaign window set: 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-15 (auto-disable at 23:59 UTC on March 15)

Please confirm you received the webhook endpoint and will do a test hit. Attached: sample weekly CSV (anonymized) and the full code list (redacted; full list available in Ops console).

Next steps: once CloudBridge confirms test webhook success, we'll flip the campaign live gate.

-Marissa
Partner Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: code_list_redacted.csv, sample_weekly_report.csv

-----
From: Eve Lin <eve.lin@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com, Thomas Cheng <thomas.cheng@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 17:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Codes issued: CloudBridge campaign live + redemption webhook details

Marissa — confirmed receipt of the code list and sample report. We'll run a test hit to the webhook tomorrow and report back. Thomas (billing) — PO confirmed; expect the wire to clear within 48 hours.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to get this live.

Best,
Eve
